en.parent.test_unlock_note: Opens the whole island so you can jump to any level. Changes nothing: his stars, his finished levels and his album stay exactly as they are, and turning this off puts every lock back.
en.parent.test_unlock_on: On. The island is open. Remember to turn it off — a map with nothing left to unlock is not much of a map for him.
en.monster.weak.stone_cub: Bring it the food it likes
en.monster.about.stone_cub: Not a bad monster at all -- just hungry. Find the food it likes and it happily moves aside.
en.monster.weak.twin_horn: Steer it into a glowing pillar
en.monster.about.twin_horn: Very strong, but slow to turn. Stand in front of a glowing pillar, then step aside in time.
en.monster.weak.red_wing: Watch its shadow to see where it lands
en.monster.about.red_wing: It dives out of the sky. The shadow on the ground tells you where it will land, so move away early.
en.monster.weak.moon_lizard: Find the one with the moon mark on its tail
en.monster.about.moon_lizard: It makes a few fake shadows. Look closely for the crescent mark on the tail to find the real one.
en.monster.weak.drill_armor: Flip the magnet switch to turn it
en.monster.about.drill_armor: The drills on its arms spin fast. Turning the magnet switch makes it change direction.
en.monster.weak.steel_spine: Raise your shield for the quake
en.monster.about.steel_spine: Hard metal spikes down its back. When it stamps, the ground shakes first as a warning.
en.monster.weak.rock_horn: Jump the charge, then hit its back
en.monster.about.rock_horn: A boulder that walks. It lowers its head before charging -- when you see that, get out of the way.
en.monster.about.sand_fist: Huge fists, slow arms. A safe circle appears before it slams, so run inside it.
en.monster.weak.crystal_armor: Collect three energy orbs in a row
en.monster.about.crystal_armor: Covered in shining crystal plates. Three energy orbs will switch the armour off for a while.
en.monster.weak.light_bug: Switch off its chest lamps in order
en.monster.about.light_bug: Quick as an insect, with lamps that light up one by one. Remember the order and it settles down.
en.monster.weak.blue_wing_armor: Fire once its wings are folded
en.monster.about.blue_wing_armor: Opening its wings whips up a whirlwind. Once it lands and folds them, take your shot.
en.monster.weak.thunder_wyvern: Start the three lightning rods in order
en.monster.about.thunder_wyvern: The great guardian of the sky. Start the three lightning rods in the right order to calm the storm.
en.monster.weak.flame_tail: Strike while the flame is low
en.monster.about.flame_tail: Its tail is always alight. The ground turns orange before it spins, so wait for the flame to die down.
en.monster.weak.blaze_claw: Block three claws in a row
en.monster.about.blaze_claw: It swings burning claws one after another. Each arm glows first; block three and it leaves an opening.
en.monster.about.shadow_wing: It hides in the dark with only its eyes and its orb showing. Light the lamps around it to find it.

zh.parent.test_unlock_note: 打开后整座岛都能进，方便你跳到任何一关。不改存档：他的星星、通关记录、图鉴都原样不动，关掉锁就全回来了。
zh.parent.test_unlock_on: 已打开，全岛开放。记得测完关掉——一张没有东西可解锁的地图，对他来说就不是地图了。
zh.monster.about.stone_cub: 它不是坏怪兽，只是肚子饿了。找到它喜欢的食物，就会开心地让开道路。
zh.monster.about.twin_horn: 力气很大，但转弯有点慢。可以站到发光石柱前，再及时闪开。
zh.monster.about.red_wing: 会从空中俯冲下来。地上的影子会告诉你它要落在哪里，提前离开就安全了。
zh.monster.weak.moon_lizard: 找到与影子相同的真身
zh.monster.about.moon_lizard: 它会制造几个假的影子。仔细观察尾巴上的月牙花纹，就能找到真正的它。
zh.monster.weak.drill_armor: 开启磁力机关改变方向
zh.monster.about.drill_armor: 身上的钻头会高速旋转。转动场景里的磁力开关，可以让它改变前进方向。
zh.monster.about.steel_spine: 背上长着坚硬的金属尖刺。它用力跺脚时，地面会先出现明显的震动提示。
zh.monster.about.rock_horn: 身体像一块会走路的岩石。它冲锋前会低下头，看到这个动作就赶快躲开。
zh.monster.about.sand_fist: 拳头很大，动作却很慢。它砸地前会出现安全圆圈，跑进去就不会受伤。
zh.monster.weak.crystal_armor: 连续收集三颗能量球破盾
zh.monster.about.crystal_armor: 身上覆盖着闪亮的晶体护甲。集齐三颗能量球，就能暂时关闭它的护甲。
zh.monster.weak.light_bug: 按正确顺序关闭胸前灯
zh.monster.about.light_bug: 像昆虫一样灵活，胸前的灯会轮流亮起。记住灯光顺序就能让它安静下来。
zh.monster.weak.blue_wing_armor: 等翅膀收起后发射光线
zh.monster.about.blue_wing_armor: 展开翅膀时会吹出旋风。等它落地、翅膀收起后，是发射光线的好机会。
zh.monster.weak.thunder_wyvern: 按顺序启动三座避雷装置
zh.monster.about.thunder_wyvern: 强大的天空守护怪兽。按正确顺序启动三座避雷装置，才能让雷电风暴停下来。
zh.monster.about.flame_tail: 尾巴一直燃烧着，转圈前地面会变成橙色。等火焰变小后再靠近。
zh.monster.about.blaze_claw: 会连续挥动带火的爪子。每次攻击前手臂都会发亮，连续挡住三次就会露出破绽。
zh.monster.about.shadow_wing: 它会藏进黑暗里，只剩眼睛和能量球发光。点亮周围的光能装置就能发现它。
